spells.name: Shadow Leap
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a visible friendly fighter within 3" of the caster, remove them from the battlefield and set them up again, anywhere on the battlefield within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee, (if you pick the caster themselves, mark their location before removing them from the battlefield).

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range the fighter can be set up from 9" to 12".

spells.name: Doom
spells.text:
**Casting Value [6+]**

Pick a visible enemy fighter within 12" of the caster to be the target. That enemy fighter is *doomed*. While an enemy fighter is *doomed* you can make them re-roll one of the following: an attack roll, a parry roll, an armour roll.

Once you do so, the fighter is no longer *doomed*.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range to 18".

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

The closest visible enemy fighter within 12" is targeted and hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage d3.

Then, pick another enemy fighter that is within 3" of the previous target and visible to it to be the new target. It is hit with the same attack.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** After the attack on the second target is resolved, pick another enemy fighter within 3" of the first two and visible to them, to be the third target. They are hit with the same attack.

spells.name: Tunnel from Below
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Place the blast template centred on the battlefield floor within 12" of the caster. Then scatter the blast template d6". You can pick d3 friendly fighters in Reserve to be set up on the battlefield floor, in the template and not engaged in melee.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** Increase the range from 12" to 15"

spells.name: Gathering Shadows
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of shadows. Friendly fighters are in cover while they are within 6" of the caster.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the aura from 6" to 9".

spells.name: Bouncing Blast
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 15" of the caster, it then scatters d6".

Each fighter in its area is hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage d3.

Then, the blast scatters d6" again, and every fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the above attack, (it is possible for the same fighter to be hit with an attack both times).

**Critical Cast [12+]:** When the blast template is first placed, it does not scatter.

spells.name: Spray of Vomit
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage 1.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** The Damage value is d3 instead of 1.

spells.name: Fetid Blades
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, then pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons to be *fetid* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *fetid* it gains the *Arcane and Poison* weapon traits.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

spells.name: Rabid Fervour
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of *rabid fervour*. Add 1 to attack rolls for melee attacks made by friendly fighters while they are within the aura.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the aura from 6" to 9".

spells.name: Rotten Armour
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a visible enemy fighter within 18" of the caster. That enemy fighter has *rotten armour* for the rest of the round. While a fighter has rotten armour worsen their Armour value by 1 (to a minimum of '-').

**Critical Cast [12+]:** The target fighter has *rotten armour* for the rest of the battle.

spells.name: Dark Vitality
spells.text:
**Casting Value [6+]**

Each friendly fighter within 3" of the caster heals 1 life.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range from 3" to 6".

spells.name: Plague Bomb
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 12" of the caster, it then scatters d6".

Each fighter in its area is hit with the following attack:

Rend –, Damage d3.

Each fighter hit by the spell becomes *poisoned*, (see *Poison* weapon trait).

**Critical Cast [12+]:** It does not scatter.
